nom: Good Molecules Sakura Hyaluronic Acid Boosting Essence

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or oily/acne-prone skin report the essence keeps them hydrated without extra grease, with some noting reduced oiliness and non-comedogenic behavior, though one long-term user of the reformulation reports it made her skin more oily and prone to closed comedones.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, very dry, or dehydrated skin consistently describe strong, lasting hydration and a soft, plump feel, though several report the reformulated version leaves their skin dry, rough, ashy, or peeling compared to the original.
segments.combination: The one reviewer identifying combination (also sensitive and acne-prone) skin reports the product helped accelerate visible improvement and left skin more hydrated.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation, no stinging, and good hydration, but a few with sensitive skin report new redness, irritation, or burning with itchy red spots after switching to the new formula.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers (including those in their 50s, 70s, and with mild rosacea) report brightening, firmness, softness, and no irritation, with one noting reduced appearance of fine lines.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using this for aging concerns report firmer, more elastic, brighter skin and softened fine lines or creases between the eyes after weeks of use; no dissent reported.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers describe marked, fast-absorbing hydration ('drinks it up', all-day hydration, plumping) with no stickiness; a minority who preferred the original formula report the new version is less hydrating or even drying and ashy.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report the essence calms redness, including for rosacea-prone or acne-prone skin; however, multiple others report the reformulated version caused new redness, irritation, or burning that resolved only after stopping use.
concerns.barrier: Reviewers describe the product as gentle, non-irritating, and compatible with layering other actives without pilling; a subset report their skin became rough, dry, or peeling after a formula change, suggesting compromised comfort for them.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers report lightening of dark spots or diminished marks on the forehead after continued use; no negative reports on spots specifically.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some improvement in acne-prone balance thanks to zinc; however, a distinct set of reviewers (mostly citing the reformulation) report breaking out badly, including cystic or itchy red spots, with recovery taking weeks.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin generally report the essence controls shine and does not add greasiness; one reviewer of the reformulated version reports the opposite, that it made her skin more oily than before.

aspects.libelle: Cute glass packaging with flip top
Reformulation seen as worse than original
Layers well under makeup and serums

extraits.texte: The old essence was my favorite skin care product ever . It literally made my skin hydrated and glow all day . Now I hate it . It' is the worst product I've ever tried . My face gets extremely dry and Ashy right after using it and it's making my skin drier by the day . Why try to fix something that wasn't broken ???? Now I'm going to have to search for another holy grail skincare product once again .

extraits.titre: Loved the original. New formula a dud.
extraits.texte: Used the original formula for a couple of years. Got compliments on my skin and gave recommendations for its use. After using this new formula for a few weeks, my skin flared up with irritation and redness that wouldn't go away. Took awhile to determine what the cause was, but since stopping use of this product, my skin is finally healing. Bring back the original formula. It was great. Won't buy this version again.

i may be in the minority in this but i really dislike this reformulation, it isn't as hydrating as the original version yet it made my skin much more oily and prone to closed comodones. i loved the original toner and bought it for years but will no longer be re-purchasing 🫠

I added this into my night time routine; skin flooding. This essence is so hydrating,smells so good and beautifully packaged (even better than the higher end products, on the other side of Ulta). I am so happy I choose this. For reference I have extremely dry skin regardless of what season, and use 4 to 5 different toners/essence a night. I apply this on first; dab and pay motion. My last application is my milky toners to lock it in. I wake up in the morning with GLOWY hydrated skin. Mature dry skin approved. I absolutely love Good Molecules 10/10

This is the fourth bottle I've purchased. I use it as a toner at night followed by either a retinol oil (also good molecules) or a hydrating essence. I have senitive, breakout prone that is both dry and oily aging skin. This is the only toner I've found that checks all of the boxes my skin needs to stay looking plump and glowy. As long as the formula stays the same, I'll never buy another toner.

This essence is so nice! I use it every morning with the good molecules hyaluronic acid serum. The zinc pca in this reduces my redness and keeps my acne prone skin balanced. It's a great first step before serums for an extra boost of hydration :)

My skin is much more elastic, firm and bright; I've been using this products for about 1 month by now and the difference in and on my skin is pretty significant, friends asked me about what I've done to my face that looks younger… that's priceless!!
